corrections: Previous controller attempt used a continuously evaluated wait-completion expression activeWaitElapsed = time - pre(tEnter) in the trigger set for wait-state transitions. Derived from the compiler log and the controller structure, this lets the same WAIT_AFTER_FILL completion relation remain true during event iteration at the boundary near 180 s, causing repeated re-triggering/chattering instead of a single settled transition. The replacement bundle below should remove the continuously self-rearming wait-completion trigger and compute timed transitions from a stored remaining delay or sampled/event-qualified state logic.

The brief gives Boolean valve commands and explicit level-balance equations using commanded valve states. No explicit evidence defines intermediate effective flow during the 0.8 s/0.6 s valve strokes, so stroke-to-flow dynamics should not be imposed as fact. If stroke dynamics are represented, that would be an assumption rather than explicit evidence.
